dialogues.jp: 講師の声が頭の上の方を流れていく。
dialogues.en: The teacher's voice could not penetrate my head.
dialogues.text: The teacher's voice could not penetrate my head.

dialogues.jp:
黒板に書かれた白い文字、目には映るが、ただ
それだけだ。
dialogues.en:
I could see the white words written on the blackboard, but
that was all my brain would process.
dialogues.text:
I could see the white words written on the blackboard, but
that was all my brain would process.

dialogues.jp:
最近、俺の中に入ってくる事柄には、ひどく制
限があるように思う。
dialogues.en:
Lately, my mind has been concentrating on just one certain
matter.
dialogues.text:
Lately, my mind has been concentrating on just one certain
matter.

dialogues.jp:
むしろそれ以外の事が考えられない、手につか
ない状態なのか……。
dialogues.en:
Of course it wouldn't think about anything else, only the
one thing I can't change...
dialogues.text:
Of course it wouldn't think about anything else, only the
one thing I can't change...

dialogues.jp: （……いかんよな実際）
dialogues.en: "(...What a sad state of affairs.)"
dialogues.text: "(...What a sad state of affairs.)"

dialogues.jp:
ただ、ふと気が付くと目が工藤の姿を追ってい
る自分がいる。
dialogues.en: I took a quick glance at Kudou.
dialogues.text: I took a quick glance at Kudou.

dialogues.jp:
小さな言動とか、癖とか、どんなことで笑った
り怒ったりするのかとか、
dialogues.en:
His little habits, way of talking, what he laughs at and
gets angry at...
dialogues.text:
His little habits, way of talking, what he laughs at and
gets angry at...

dialogues.jp:
そんなことを考えて、気づけば時間が過ぎてい
る。
dialogues.en:
THinking about those things so much, made the time pass by
quickly.
dialogues.text:
THinking about those things so much, made the time pass by
quickly.

dialogues.jp: それはとても不毛な行為だ。
dialogues.en: Completely unproductive time, as well.
dialogues.text: Completely unproductive time, as well.

dialogues.jp:
答えはうすうすわかってる。でもその答えを出
してしまうのが怖かった。
dialogues.en:
A little part of me wanted to know his answer. Yet I was
scared to find out.
dialogues.text:
A little part of me wanted to know his answer. Yet I was
scared to find out.

dialogues.jp: 考えてもみろ、
dialogues.en: So all I could do was think.
dialogues.text: So all I could do was think.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、男にファーストキスを奪われて……しか
もそいつに恋をしていますなんて、
dialogues.en:
Having my first kiss stolen by a guy... yet ending up
falling in love with him...
dialogues.text:
Having my first kiss stolen by a guy... yet ending up
falling in love with him...

dialogues.jp: そんなの笑い話にしかならないじゃないか。
dialogues.en: That's such a laughable thing to happen.
dialogues.text: That's such a laughable thing to happen.

dialogues.jp: 「いや、どちらかというと笑えない話だ」
dialogues.en: "No, this entire situation is laughable.
dialogues.text: "No, this entire situation is laughable.

dialogues.jp: だからそれを認めるわけにはいかなかった。
dialogues.en: That's why I can't let anyone know.
dialogues.text: That's why I can't let anyone know.

dialogues.jp: 終業のチャイムが鳴り響く。
dialogues.en: The last bell rang throughout the school.
dialogues.text: The last bell rang throughout the school.

dialogues.jp:
そんなことを考えながら授業時間を過ごすうち
に一日が終わってしまった。
dialogues.en:
Just thinking about things like that made an entire school
day pass by.
dialogues.text:
Just thinking about things like that made an entire school
day pass by.

dialogues.jp: 「やれやれ……」
dialogues.en: "Oh boy..."
dialogues.text: "Oh boy..."

dialogues.jp:
少し、気分転換をしよう。そう考えた俺は桜公
園へ寄り道して帰ることにした。
dialogues.en:
I needed a change of pace. I decided to walk through the
Sakura Park back home.
dialogues.text:
I needed a change of pace. I decided to walk through the
Sakura Park back home.

dialogues.jp:
風が桜の花びらを散らす。枯れることのない桜
の花を……。
dialogues.en:
The wind scattered the sakura petals. The sakura petals that
would not die...
dialogues.text:
The wind scattered the sakura petals. The sakura petals that
would not die...

dialogues.jp:
桜の木に寄りかかって、ひらひらと舞い散る花
びらをぼんやりと眺める。
dialogues.en:
I leaned against one of the many trees, and gazed at the
dancing, fluttering sakura petals.
dialogues.text:
I leaned against one of the many trees, and gazed at the
dancing, fluttering sakura petals.

dialogues.jp: 「……葉桜が好きって言ってたっけ」
dialogues.en: "...He said he liked sakura trees in leaf."
dialogues.text: "...He said he liked sakura trees in leaf."

dialogues.jp: 少なくともこの島で、葉桜は臨めない。
dialogues.en: But this island hasn't ever seen them.
dialogues.text: But this island hasn't ever seen them.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、少し残念な気分になる。
dialogues.en: I felt a twinge of regret inside me.
dialogues.text: I felt a twinge of regret inside me.

dialogues.jp: 「……重症だな」
dialogues.en: "...I've got it really bad."
dialogues.text: "...I've got it really bad."

dialogues.jp: はたと気が付いた。もう苦笑するしかない。
dialogues.en:
When I noticed it, I couldn't help but smile bitterly to
myself.
dialogues.text:
When I noticed it, I couldn't help but smile bitterly to
myself.

dialogues.jp:
気付けばまた、あいつのことを考えてるのだか
ら。
dialogues.en: Even now, I was still thinking of him.
dialogues.text: Even now, I was still thinking of him.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あら？　朝倉君……」
dialogues.en: "Oh? Asakura-kun..."
dialogues.text: "Oh? Asakura-kun..."

dialogues.jp: 涼やかなこの声は……。
dialogues.en: A bright voice, belonging to...
dialogues.text: A bright voice, belonging to...

dialogues.jp: 「よう、ことり」
dialogues.en: "Hi, Kotori."
dialogues.text: "Hi, Kotori."

dialogues.jp: 右手を軽くあげて見せた。
dialogues.en: I waved to her when I saw her.
dialogues.text: I waved to her when I saw her.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉君もお散歩？」
dialogues.en: "Are you taking a walk?"
dialogues.text: "Are you taking a walk?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……まぁね」
dialogues.en: "...I guess."
dialogues.text: "...I guess."

dialogues.jp: そんなにいいものでもないけれど……。
dialogues.en: I'm not just doing that though...
dialogues.text: I'm not just doing that though...

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉君……最近悩んでるみたいだね」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-kun... you've been in deep thought a lot lately."
dialogues.text: "Asakura-kun... you've been in deep thought a lot lately."

dialogues.jp: ことりが俺を心配そうに覗き込んでくる。
dialogues.en: She looked at me, her worry evident.
dialogues.text: She looked at me, her worry evident.

dialogues.jp: 「わかるか？　実は五月病なんだ」
dialogues.en: "You realized? I've been having the new-school-year blues."
dialogues.text: "You realized? I've been having the new-school-year blues."

dialogues.jp:
両手を広げて大きなジェスチャー、平静を装っ
てみる。
dialogues.en:
I spread my arms wide in gesture, as if that explained
everything.
dialogues.text:
I spread my arms wide in gesture, as if that explained
everything.

dialogues.jp: そんな俺に不審そうな眼差しをむけることり。
dialogues.en: But the suspicious look she gave me,
dialogues.text: But the suspicious look she gave me,

dialogues.jp: 俺はゆっくりと肩を落とした。
dialogues.en: made me droop my shoulders in defeat.
dialogues.text: made me droop my shoulders in defeat.

dialogues.jp: 「そんなふうに……見えるのか？」
dialogues.en: "You really... think so?"
dialogues.text: "You really... think so?"

dialogues.jp: ぽつりと呟くように、尋ねてみる。
dialogues.en: I asked her, muttering my words.
dialogues.text: I asked her, muttering my words.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「うん」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.jp: きっぱりと頷くことり。その目は真剣だった。
dialogues.en: A firm nod. Her eyes were indeed serious.
dialogues.text: A firm nod. Her eyes were indeed serious.

dialogues.jp:
ことりはきっと本当に俺のことを心配してくれ
ているのだ。
dialogues.en: She's really worried about me.
dialogues.text: She's really worried about me.

dialogues.en: "Sorry..."
dialogues.text: "Sorry..."

dialogues.jp: 俺は覚悟をきめて話し始めた。
dialogues.en: I made a decision, and prepared myself to explain.
dialogues.text: I made a decision, and prepared myself to explain.

dialogues.jp:
「実は……その……俺はどうやら、恋をしてい
　るらしいんだ」
dialogues.en:
"The truth is... well... I think I've sort of fallen in
love."
dialogues.text:
"The truth is... well... I think I've sort of fallen in
love."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「らしい、って……なに？　自分でも分からな
　いの？」
dialogues.en: "Sort of... why? You're not sure about it?"
dialogues.text: "Sort of... why? You're not sure about it?"

dialogues.jp:
不思議そうに目をしばたかせることり。確かに、
自分で言ってても訳がわからない。
dialogues.en:
Kotori looked at me curiously. I didn't know how to explain
it either.
dialogues.text:
Kotori looked at me curiously. I didn't know how to explain
it either.

dialogues.jp: 「……らしいっていうのはつまりさ」
dialogues.en: "..."Sort of" is the simplest way to put it."
dialogues.text: "..."Sort of" is the simplest way to put it."

dialogues.jp: 視線をあちこちに泳がせる。
dialogues.en: I took glances all around me.
dialogues.text: I took glances all around me.

dialogues.jp:
なんていったらいいのだろう……俺は情けない
気分で俯いた。
dialogues.en: How am I supposed to say this... I hung my head in shame.
dialogues.text: How am I supposed to say this... I hung my head in shame.

dialogues.jp:
「なんていうか……普通、そんな感情を抱くべ
　き相手じゃないから…………」
dialogues.en:
"It's like... because the other person involved, it isn't
normal..."
dialogues.text:
"It's like... because the other person involved, it isn't
normal..."

dialogues.jp:
「これは恋愛とかじゃない、そう思い込もうと
　してて」
dialogues.en: "So it couldn't be real love, or so I thought."
dialogues.text: "So it couldn't be real love, or so I thought."

dialogues.jp:
「でも……やっぱり、俺……そいつのこと、本
　気で好きなのかも……」
dialogues.en: "But... lately, I... think I've really fallen in love..."
dialogues.text: "But... lately, I... think I've really fallen in love..."

dialogues.jp:
それでも、口に出したことで、少しだけ重荷が
取れたような気分になる。
dialogues.en:
As I continued to speak, I felt like the load on my
shoulders was slowly being taken away.
dialogues.text:
As I continued to speak, I felt like the load on my
shoulders was slowly being taken away.

dialogues.jp: そう、これは一方的な｛ざんげ／懺悔｝だ。
dialogues.en: Yeah, this is an anonymous confession.
dialogues.text: Yeah, this is an anonymous confession.

dialogues.jp:
ことりは俺が誰の事を好きなのかなんて知らな
いはずで、
dialogues.en: Kotori doesn't know who the person I really like is,
dialogues.text: Kotori doesn't know who the person I really like is,

dialogues.jp:
俺は、そういう肝心な部分を伏せる事で、結局、
保身している｛ひきょうもの／卑怯者｝なのだ。
dialogues.en:
So since i'm a coward, I'd just make sure to leave out that
detail.
dialogues.text:
So since i'm a coward, I'd just make sure to leave out that
detail.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……それって工藤君？」
dialogues.en: "...Is it Kudou-kun?"
dialogues.text: "...Is it Kudou-kun?"

dialogues.jp:
ところがことりの口から、あっさりとそんな答
えが返ってくる。
dialogues.en: Somehow, she came to that conclusion as if it wasa nothing.
dialogues.text: Somehow, she came to that conclusion as if it wasa nothing.

dialogues.jp: あまりの事に、俺は言葉を失ってしまった。
dialogues.en: I was left speechless.
dialogues.text: I was left speechless.

dialogues.jp:
もしかして、誰も気づいてないと思っていたの
は俺だけなのか……。
dialogues.en:
Don't tell me I was the only one who thought that no one
noticed...
dialogues.text:
Don't tell me I was the only one who thought that no one
noticed...

dialogues.jp:
ふかく、ふかく、ひと呼吸した後、俺は観念し
て大きく頷いた。
dialogues.en: After a couple of deep breaths, I resignedly nodded.
dialogues.text: After a couple of deep breaths, I resignedly nodded.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Hmmm..."
dialogues.text: "Hmmm..."

dialogues.jp:
ことりは、そんな俺をまじまじと見つめ――そ
して何を思ったのか小さくふきだした。
dialogues.en:
Kotori took a long hard look at me-- then whatever she was
thinking of made her laugh slightly.
dialogues.text:
Kotori took a long hard look at me-- then whatever she was
thinking of made her laugh slightly.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ぷっ…………うふふふっ………………そっか、
　そうなんだ〜……………………」
dialogues.en: "Heh... hehehehehe... that's right, that's right..."
dialogues.text: "Heh... hehehehehe... that's right, that's right..."

dialogues.jp:
俺の悩みなんて、大した事じゃない、こちらの
肩の力がぬけてしまうような、そんな感じの笑
い。
dialogues.en: Her laughter felt like she was belittling all my troubles.
dialogues.text: Her laughter felt like she was belittling all my troubles.

dialogues.jp: 「……な、なんだよ」
dialogues.en: "...W, what."
dialogues.text: "...W, what."

dialogues.jp: 人が決死の覚悟で告白したっていうのに……。
dialogues.en: When people confess of sorts, and you react like that...
dialogues.text: When people confess of sorts, and you react like that...

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ふふふふ…………ごめんね」
dialogues.en: "Hahahaha.... I'm sorry."
dialogues.text: "Hahahaha.... I'm sorry."

dialogues.jp: くすくすと笑いながらことりは謝る。
dialogues.en: Kotori apologized, although she continued to giggle.
dialogues.text: Kotori apologized, although she continued to giggle.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「でも……工藤君、うらやましいな」
dialogues.en: "But, hee... I'm envious of Kudou-kun."
dialogues.text: "But, hee... I'm envious of Kudou-kun."

dialogues.jp:
かろうじて聞き取れるくらいの小声でことりは
つぶやいた。
dialogues.en:
I was just barely able to hear what Kotori said in a
whisper.
dialogues.text:
I was just barely able to hear what Kotori said in a
whisper.

dialogues.jp:
聞きとがめてぱっと顔をあげる俺に、彼女は小
さく首を振った。
dialogues.en: Questioning what I had heard, she quickly shook her head.
dialogues.text: Questioning what I had heard, she quickly shook her head.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あ、ううん。なんでもない」
dialogues.en: "Ah, um, nevermind. It's nothing."
dialogues.text: "Ah, um, nevermind. It's nothing."

dialogues.jp: そして、にっこりと笑う。
dialogues.en: And the giggling continued once more.
dialogues.text: And the giggling continued once more.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「私は二人のこと応援しちゃうよ」
dialogues.en: "I'd support you two."
dialogues.text: "I'd support you two."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Kotori..."
dialogues.text: "Kotori..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉君は自分の気持ちを誤魔化す必要なんて
　ないと思うよ。工藤君のことが好きなら好きっ
　て認めたほうがいいんじゃない？」
dialogues.en:
"There's no need for you to try and deceive yourself about
your feelings. If you like Kudou-kun, you should accept it,
right?"
dialogues.text:
"There's no need for you to try and deceive yourself about
your feelings. If you like Kudou-kun, you should accept it,
right?"

dialogues.jp:
俺だって、そういう気持ちがあることを認めて
いないわけじゃない。
dialogues.en: I couldn't accept that those feelings existed.
dialogues.text: I couldn't accept that those feelings existed.

dialogues.jp: ただ、その気持ちを認めたくないだけだ。
dialogues.en: Because they shouldn't exist in the first place.
dialogues.text: Because they shouldn't exist in the first place.

dialogues.jp: だってそんなの、……普通じゃない。
dialogues.en: After all, they're... not normal.
dialogues.text: After all, they're... not normal.

dialogues.jp: 「そんなに簡単にいくもんかよ」
dialogues.en: "That's easier said than done."
dialogues.text: "That's easier said than done."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「あはは……でも、本当。早く正直になりなよ、
　ねっ」
dialogues.en: "Ahaha... but really. You should be honest, and quickly."
dialogues.text: "Ahaha... but really. You should be honest, and quickly."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「でも百歩譲ってそう認めたとしてもだな……」
dialogues.en:
"But there's no point in accepting it if I'm unwilling to do
so..."
dialogues.text:
"But there's no point in accepting it if I'm unwilling to do
so..."

dialogues.jp:
何故か、奇妙な自信に満ちた、ことり。おずお
ずと反論する俺に、
dialogues.en:
Why are you so confident about that, Kotori? All I could do
was meekly object.
dialogues.text:
Why are you so confident about that, Kotori? All I could do
was meekly object.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「譲らないの、事実でしょ」
dialogues.en: "Just admit it, it's the truth."
dialogues.text: "Just admit it, it's the truth."

dialogues.jp:
デモもストライキもないでしょとばかり、び
しっ、と鼻先に指を突きつけてくる。
dialogues.en:
She hit the strike zone perfectly, poking my in the nose
with her finger.
dialogues.text:
She hit the strike zone perfectly, poking my in the nose
with her finger.

dialogues.jp: 勢いに気圧されて、俺は素直に頷いた。
dialogues.en: At her calm, yet direct words, I obediently nodded.
dialogues.text: At her calm, yet direct words, I obediently nodded.

dialogues.jp:
「でも、俺が、自分の気持ちに正直になったと
　しても、工藤自身はこんな俺を気色悪いって
　思うかもしれないだろ？」
dialogues.en:
"But, if I'm honest with my feelings, you don't think Kudou
would take it badly?"
dialogues.text:
"But, if I'm honest with my feelings, you don't think Kudou
would take it badly?"

dialogues.jp:
普通はそう思うだろう。俺だっていきなり杉並
に熱い視線を投げかけられたりしたら……。
dialogues.en:
That's normal to think after all. If I thought Suginami had
the hots for me...
dialogues.text:
That's normal to think after all. If I thought Suginami had
the hots for me...

dialogues.jp: ……考えるだけで背筋に冷たいものが走る。
dialogues.en:
...I felt cold shivers running down my spine just from
thinking about that.
dialogues.text:
...I felt cold shivers running down my spine just from
thinking about that.

dialogues.jp:
「それにあいつ、好きな女の子いるみたいなこ
　と言ってたし………………」
dialogues.en: "And he's said before that there's a girl he likes..."
dialogues.text: "And he's said before that there's a girl he likes..."

dialogues.jp:
ちらりとことりの顔を窺いつつ、俺は小声でつ
けたした。
dialogues.en:
I took a peek at Kotori's reaction as I said my piece in a
small voice.
dialogues.text:
I took a peek at Kotori's reaction as I said my piece in a
small voice.

dialogues.jp:
ことりと工藤というのは凄くお似合いな気がす
る。
dialogues.en: Kotori and Kudou really look like they go well together.
dialogues.text: Kotori and Kudou really look like they go well together.

dialogues.jp: 誰もが｛うらや／羨｝む美男美女カップル。
dialogues.en:
They're the kind of pretty-boy-pretty-girl couple that
everyone would be jealous of.
dialogues.text:
They're the kind of pretty-boy-pretty-girl couple that
everyone would be jealous of.

dialogues.jp:
実際ここ数日工藤を目で追っていたからわかる
のだが、二人はとても仲がよいのだ。
dialogues.en:
And in recent days, since I've been basically spying on
Kudou, I've noticed that the two of them are really close.
dialogues.text:
And in recent days, since I've been basically spying on
Kudou, I've noticed that the two of them are really close.

dialogues.jp:
もしかして、ことりも工藤の事が好きなのかな
……。
dialogues.en: Maybe, Kotori actually likes Kudou as well...
dialogues.text: Maybe, Kotori actually likes Kudou as well...

dialogues.jp: ちらりとそんな事が頭を｛かす／掠｝めていった。
dialogues.en: That thought sneakily invaded my mind.
dialogues.text: That thought sneakily invaded my mind.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そんなことないって。大丈夫大丈夫」
dialogues.en: "Don't worry about that. It'd be fine, fine!"
dialogues.text: "Don't worry about that. It'd be fine, fine!"

dialogues.jp:
そんな俺に対して、なんだかいやに楽しげに笑
いながら、首を振ってみせることり。
dialogues.en:
She easily brushed off my words, shaking her head and
smiling happily.
dialogues.text:
She easily brushed off my words, shaking her head and
smiling happily.

dialogues.jp: 「……だから、なんでそんな断言するみたいに」
dialogues.en: "...How can you declare that so easily?"
dialogues.text: "...How can you declare that so easily?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「うふふ、セブンセンシズ」
dialogues.en: "Ehehe, seventh sense."
dialogues.text: "Ehehe, seventh sense."

dialogues.jp:
なんでもお見通しなんですよ〜、というような
笑顔を見せた後、ことりは桜吹雪の中を歩き出
した。
dialogues.en:
With all "that's all I have to say~" smile, Kotori started
to walk into the storm of sakura petals.
dialogues.text:
With all "that's all I have to say~" smile, Kotori started
to walk into the storm of sakura petals.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「いーい？　自分に正直に、だよ！」
dialogues.en: "Okay? Be honest with yourself!"
dialogues.text: "Okay? Be honest with yourself!"

dialogues.jp: そんな一言を残して。
dialogues.en: With that, she disappeared.
dialogues.text: With that, she disappeared.

dialogues.en: "...Haha."
dialogues.text: "...Haha."

dialogues.jp: なんとなく、笑いがこぼれた。
dialogues.en: I started laughing to myself.
dialogues.text: I started laughing to myself.

dialogues.jp: 自分に正直に、か……。
dialogues.en: Be honest with myself, huh...
dialogues.text: Be honest with myself, huh...

dialogues.jp: まったく、ことりにはかなわない。
dialogues.en: Sheesh, Kotori, that's asking a lot.
dialogues.text: Sheesh, Kotori, that's asking a lot.

dialogues.jp:
でも、それが簡単にいけば、最初からこんなに
悩みはしないのだ。
dialogues.en: If it was that easy, I wouldn't be this troubled.
dialogues.text: If it was that easy, I wouldn't be this troubled.

dialogues.jp: ◆ことりさんはお見通し◆
dialogues.en: ◆Kotori's Conjecture◆
dialogues.text: ◆Kotori's Conjecture◆

dialogues.jp:
結局、授業も何も手につかず、一日中ずっと工
藤の事を考えていた。
dialogues.en:
In the end, I did nothing throughout class except think
about Kudou.
dialogues.text:
In the end, I did nothing throughout class except think
about Kudou.

dialogues.jp:
帰り道に出会ったことりに相談を持ちかけるも、
「自分に正直に」なんて、そんな簡単に行けば
世話はない。
dialogues.en:
On the way home, I bumped into Kotori. I confided in her,
and she told me to "Be honest with myself", but something so
simple doesn't help.
dialogues.text:
On the way home, I bumped into Kotori. I confided in her,
and she told me to "Be honest with myself", but something so
simple doesn't help.
